tenure rights

  • CURIE: gmeow:tenureRights
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureRights
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The machine-readable rights statement (permissions, prohibitions, duties) that governs this land tenure. Links to the rights facility rights facility by reference. Non-functional: multiple legal instruments may apply to the same tenure (e.g. national law + local ordinance + indigenous treaty).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:LandTenure -> gmeow:RightsStatement

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:tenureRights from gmeow:LandTenure to gmeow:RightsStatement when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:LandTenure, gmeow:RightsStatement

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to link a land tenure to the machine-readable rights statement governing it; non-functional.

Avoid when

  • Avoid inlining deontic rules — reference a RightsStatement from the rights slice.

How to use

  • Point gmeow:tenureRights at one or more gmeow:RightsStatement instances; multiple instruments may apply.

Examples

  • ex:lt gmeow:tenureRights ex:rights.
